about: LABELS, not data: where each ingest case of the timeline happens, and what the store holds after every batch is ingested in order. Written by hand. A delivery is a batch file, named by its path under batches/. A record reference names a record as the decision tools do (source, record_kind, external_id).

late_reply.expect: Two replies to a thread of the first week arrive in the second week's window: the thread is written again with four messages and its occurred_at moves to the last reply.

edited_message.expect: The same message id with new text (and an edited_at the parsers do not read): the thread is written again, its occurred_at stays.

deleted_thread.expect: A tombstone deletes the thread and its chunks.

growing_mail_thread.expect: One message in the second week, three from the third; the third delivery sends the same three again and changes nothing.

incomplete_window.expect: The third week of mail is incomplete: its records are stored and the checkpoint stays at 2026-09-21T00:00:00Z. The next delivery starts at the same place, holds the whole rest and moves the checkpoint to 2026-10-05T00:00:00Z.

snapshot_deletion.expect: The notes of a two-minute call are deleted in the note-taker. The last meetings delivery is a snapshot of its window and leaves them out, so the record becomes a tombstone (reconciled).
